bundle.shortDescription: Learn the Pokémon Trading Card Game against an AI opponent
bundle.longDescription: Play 109 classic and modern Pokémon TCG decks against Gary, an AI opponent, while the Professor coaches you. Works offline with the built-in CPU engine or a local decision model (Kev); the hosted Jev model is optional and its API key is kept in the macOS Keychain.
